title: Battleship: sunk detection and end condition
description:
Detect when all segments of a ship are damaged (sunk), and when all ships of a player are sunk (game over).

## Sunk detection
After each hit, check: are all components with the same ship property now damaged?
CEL expression per ship: components.filter(c, c.ship == "carrier").all(c, c.damaged == true)
Or simpler: count damaged segments == ship length

## Sunk announcement
When a ship is sunk, server broadcasts which ship type was sunk. This reveals the ship TYPE but not the positions of remaining ships.

## End condition
All 5 ships of one player are sunk → opponent wins.
CEL: all_ships_sunk (precomputed boolean) or compose from per-ship sunk checks.

## Implementation
Could be a perturber effect triggered after each attack:
```json
{"if": "ship_sunk", "then": {"sequence": [
  {"set_counter": {"counter": "ships_remaining_player2", "value": -1}}
]}}
```
End condition: ships_remaining == 0

Or simpler: count unsunk ship segments after each attack.

## Test
Sink all 5 ships of player 2 (17 hits total). Verify game ends with player 1 winning. Verify sunk announcements for each ship.
close_reason: Sunk detection implemented in Fire handler. Compares hit_count to span length after each hit. When ship sunk: emits Sunk event and decrements opponent ships_remaining counter. End condition (ships_remaining == 0) evaluable via existing CEL. Tested with sunk detection test.
